parrafos: Requintu (hereinafter, "the application") is a platform that connects travelers and users with local businesses in Colombia. This policy explains what personal data we collect, what we use it for and what rights you have over it.

items: Account: name, email address and password (stored encrypted with bcrypt, never in plain text).
Location and interest: department and municipalities you search for on the map to organize information by area.
Content you post: places you create, reviews, ratings and news feed posts, including the texts you write.
Images: photos you upload for your profile, places or offers. They are stored securely by external services (Cloudinary).
Technical data: access date and time and session identifiers required for the service to work.
Create and manage your user account.
Let you search, create and review local businesses in Colombia.
Show the content of the community news feed.
Send you password recovery emails when you request them.
Ensure platform safety (prevention of abuse, inappropriate content and unauthorized access).
parrafos: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for advertising purposes.

secciones.titulo: 4. Third parties involved in the service
items: Infrastructure and database: cloud hosting and managed database provider (TiDB Cloud).
Transactional email: Brevo (only to send you the password recovery link).
Distribution platforms: Vercel (web) and Google Play (Android app).
parrafos: These providers only access the data needed to provide their service and comply with their own security policies.

We implement technical and organizational measures: encrypted passwords (bcrypt), rotating session tokens, encrypted connections (HTTPS), input validation and an inappropriate content filter. No system is infallible, but we continuously update our measures.
We keep your data while your account is active. If you request account deletion, we delete or anonymize your personal data, except what the law requires us to keep.

You can exercise the rights of access, rectification, erasure and objection by writing to the contact email shown below. From your profile you can edit your data, and the account can be deleted from the app itself or by asking the administrator.
The service is intended for people over 13 years old. We do not knowingly collect data from minors under that age.
We will update this policy when needed. The current version will always be available on this page and, if there are relevant changes, we will let you know in the app.
For any question about this privacy policy or the handling of your data, write to us at: aycardy93@gmail.com.
